title: Fraudster jailed for using 10K bots and AI songs to outstream Taylor Swift
script:
Ten thousand bots generated millions of fake streams.
Michael Smith used artificial intelligence to stream automated songs.
His software played those tracks over the course of the scheme.
A federal court in New York sentenced him to eighteen months in prison.
His streaming numbers were compared against major artists like Taylor Swift.
Would you listen to an AI-generated song?
